How the day runs

  • MorningOpen this page. Fix the red list first — everything above the fold is what is already late or blocked.
  • DuringTap a status chip to move work along: To do → Doing → Done. Truly blocked? Tap to Stuck — that is a flare, not a failure, and it jumps to the top here.
  • EveningFile your Day Close before you leave. Under a minute, then a ✅ in the WhatsApp group.
